messages:
elaine: FYI partner AeroCloud just asked for an APAC-SW onramp. They need 2x A100-80GB reserved SKUs + marketplace entitlement by May 20. Also asking for signed MOU and co-marketing. Any blockers?
jules: They filled the marketplace onboarding form yesterday. I moved it to partner-ops queue. Waiting on quota approval from cloud vendor.
viv: @jules can you paste the SKU list + expected qps? I need that to size infra pools and routing.
jules: SKU list: `a100-80gb x2`, `t4 x1` for burst. Expected steady qps ~150 req/s, peak 400 req/s (short bursts).
marc: @viv we have some reserved capacity in APAC-SW but not contiguous GPUs for 2x80GB. We can either: short-term borrow from eu-west reserved pool (cross-region routing) or request a quota bump from vendor. Which do you prefer?
elaine: Short-term borrow is fine for a 2-week overlap as long as latency impact <50ms. If borrow, we need routing + cost approvals. Otherwise start quota request ASAP.
ashley-sales: Also pinging marketing/legal — partner wants a joint blog the week after go-live. Legal flagged the MOU template needs partner details. @legal-bot any ETA on MOU review?
legal-bot: New MOU request created: `MOU-2026-0327`. Typical turnaround 3-5 business days if no custom terms. Please attach partner company address + logo.
jules: I attached partner billing entity + logo to the onboarding ticket.
marc: I raised infra ticket `INFRA-7892` to plan cross-region routing and cost estimates. If we borrow from EU-W we should enable prefix caching to reduce cross-region token egress.
deploy-bot: Marketplace quota ticket opened: https://partners.redwood.com/tickets/PM-4412 — assigned to partner-ops.
viv: Action items: 1) @jules confirm quota request submitted to vendor (cloud ticket) 2) @marc plan short-term borrow + test run 3) @ashley-sales confirm announcement window and PR owners 4) @elaine coordinate MOU sign-off.
ashley-sales: Announcement window tentative: June 3-10. Prefer June 8 if legal sign-off done by May 24.
elaine: I'll own MOU sign-off. I've requested partner signatures today. If we get MOU by May 21 we can meet June 8.
jules: Cloud vendor replied — they need a formal quota request doc with SKU + justification. I uploaded `quota_request_AeroCloud_APAC-SW.pdf` to the ticket.
marc: Test run tomorrow 9:00 UTC to validate cross-region latency under burst. I'll post results.
viv: Thx. If test shows >60ms p95 we revert and accelerate quota bump.
elaine: Quick note for ops: partner also asked for marketplace billing mapping to their reseller ID. @jules can you add reseller mapping to PM-4412?
jules: Done. Added `reseller_id: AC-RESELLER-97` to the ticket.
ashley-sales: PR checklist: co-author from AeroCloud, three review cycles, a quote from their CTO, and a joint screenshot of dashboard. I'll start draft and share by EOD Friday.
marc: Test results: p95 cross-region burst = 42ms, p99 = 95ms (some outliers). Looks acceptable for short-term.
viv: Good. Plan: short-term borrow enabled, run canary on 10% traffic, monitor token egress and latency.
elaine: Can we get a cost estimate for two-week cross-region borrow? @marc
marc: Estimate posted in `INFRA-7892` — ~$4.2k additional egress + GPU time for 2 weeks.
ashley-sales: Noted. I'll include costs in go/no-go sync with AeroCloud.
elaine: Great — next sync Wednesday 1600 UTC. I'll update the partner with tentative June 8 announcement and MOU timeline. :white_check_mark:
